results.description: A1.5 redefined (pilot 2026-07-10, orchestrator, pre-confirmatory): the loop-closure signature is the arm-by-kappa INTERACTION of freezing. In the closed loop, control releases freezing (frozen cells in the acute band concentrate at kappa 0.2-0.6 and vanish at kappa >= 1.0); under exact replay kappa cannot alter exposure and the frozen count is flat. Interaction = (closed low - closed high) - (yoked low - yoked high), in frozen-cell counts.
results.label: support
